name: expo-design-system
description: Framework (OSS). Build and maintain a design system inside an Expo app - a reusable theme of design tokens (color, spacing, typography, radius, shadow, motion), reusable component structure with variant/size/state prop conventions, and rules for when to extract a repeated view into a shared component. Use when creating or organizing theme files and design tokens (theme.ts / theme/), extending an existing theme or styling library (NativeWind, Tamagui, Restyle, Unistyles) in its own idiom, standar
author: expo
summary_zh: 用于在 Expo 应用中构建和维护设计系统的开源框架，适合统一主题、设计令牌和组件规范，减少重复样式与视图。
